edge_cases_covered: SRM p < 0.001 -> verdict starts with the do-not-trust sentence
constant metric in every arm -> CONSTANT_METRIC
missing pre-period values -> rows dropped and counted (null_pre_period)
non-binary values in a binary metric -> dropped and counted (non_binary_value)
planned_split length differs from arm count -> PLANNED_SPLIT_MISMATCH
zero variance in both arms of one comparison -> degenerate + warning
